footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Watsco: after $90.6M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $32.8M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 5.0% to $7.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 28.0%, versus 26.8% a year earlier, and operating income fell 7.9% to $720M, a 10.0% margin.
Net income fell 7.0% to $464M, or $12.25 per share. Operating cash flow was $570M and free cash flow $535M, versus $743M; Watsco returned $474M through dividends.
sources: Watsco, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
